name: 返信付きチャンネル投稿
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. ONE Lighthouse component LH03-0009「返信付きチャンネル投稿」.
Image1 ORIGINAL is primary for icon/control geometry, proportions, optical stroke, alignment, small status and reply anatomy. Image2 mock is secondary for exact Japanese content and logical390x260 structure; do not inherit its rough speech-bubble substitute, mint avatars, missing fine status or placeholder details. Image3 style only.
White compact channel post on pure white canvas, no enclosing outer card. Left36px circular white avatar, fine neutral outline, forest-green「山」. At right header: bold「山田 はるか」, then original small house/garden emoji status artwork as in Image1; quiet time「09:59」aligned same baseline.
Below exact regular sentence「こちらの記事も参考になります。」then forest-green link「ライトハウスの学びの資料」.
Indented link preview with ORIGINAL quiet NEUTRAL vertical left rule (not mint stripe). Provider line: original small neutral-gray square placeholder icon, then exact「ライトハウス｜資料」in quiet gray. Title below in forest-green, EXACT THREE lines:
チームで考える
ワークショップの
進め方
At title area's right, retain original small38x38px gray rounded-square thumbnail placeholder. It is genuinely blank in source; do not invent a photo or play glyph.
Bottom reply entry: small white outlined avatar with green「佐」, then ORIGINAL secondary generic-person avatar glyph in a small slate/neutral rounded-square shape, then green「3件の返信」, then quiet「今日 14:43」. IMPORTANT: our mock's hollow SPEECH BUBBLE is inaccurate here; source shows a generic PERSON/avatar, not a speech bubble. Match its actual rounded silhouette and optical weight. Preserve count3 and times.
Typography locked: Meiryo Bold14/24 for author and initial letters, Meiryo Regular14/24 body and shared link, Meiryo Bold20/28 title (3lines), Meiryo Regular12/16 time/provider/reply labels, tracking0. Uniformly scale all geometry, keep established wrapping and aligned content column. White member circles, no mint fill, coherent slate supporting glyphs, forest-green meaningful links. No extra primary button/gradient because this post's actions are text links.
Landscape3:2, one full readable post with modest white margins, complete Japanese text and all source controls. Exclude screen header/unread badge/NEW separator/next post/reaction teaching purple card/composer/phone outside selected region. Do not invent avatars' photographs; catalog localization to initials is intentional. Restrained depth only where it aids the link grouping.
reviewNotes: 原画像を形状/微細部の主参照にして、モックで欠落した家の状態絵文字・提供元の中立四角、人物アバターへ復元。ミントアバターを白い輪郭へ、緑の左線を原画像通り中立線へ。画像を目視し、日本語全文・題名3行・09:59・3件の返信・今日14:43・実際の空サムネイル状態を確認。リンク/返信は青の意味を森林緑へ統一適応。厳密なフォント計測・リンク/返信の実動作・編集可能性・所有者承認は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
